messages:
megan: Quick thread to assign owners for the DR follow-ups from Friday's postmortem. Need clear owners, short ETAs, and a single tracking epic.

priya: I'll own cross-region backups validation (snapshots, retention labels, CRC checks). ETA: 2026-04-01 for docs + verification commands.

daniel: I'll take routing fallback rules and canary automation + tests. Plan: PR by 2026-03-26.

marco: I'll pair with daniel for traffic-splitting + latency thresholds. Also add Prometheus alerts for canary regressions. ETA: 2026-03-27.

sylvia: I'll update the restore runbook: warm-standby boot, KV cache priming, and add a 10-min smoke test. PR by 2026-04-02.

alex: I'll prepare the chaos script for the game-day and run a dry-run with SRE. Dry-run ready by 2026-04-03.

megan: ACTIONS (please ack):
- priya: backups verification + preflight commands in runbook — 2026-04-01
- daniel: routing policy refactor + canary automation — 2026-03-26
- marco: traffic shaping playbook + alerts — 2026-03-27
- sylvia: restore runbook KV prime + smoke test — 2026-04-02
- alex: chaos script + dry-run checklist — 2026-04-03

ops-bot: Reminder: create EPIC to track all remediation tasks. Daily pings until tasks are in progress.

priya: I'll create the EPIC and link tasks. Will post the number once done.

megan: One more: SRE noticed DNS TTLs added ~2m lag in last failover. Need temp TTL rollback automation for game-day. ACTION: daniel + alex to add automation by 2026-04-05.

daniel: Ack. Will include TTL change + auto-revert play in the routing PR.

marco: Also propose adding a monthly DR quick-check (15m checklist) to catch recurring routing+snapshot lag. I'll draft cadence.

megan: Thanks — I'll turn this into the handoff doc and post the EPIC link. Update the EPIC as you progress. If blockers appear, flag here.

ops-bot: EPIC-5501 created and linked: TASK-1210..TASK-1214. Owners assigned.

priya: EPIC-5501 acked. I'll start with the snapshot CRC steps and post a short test script.

megan: Closing thread for now. Keep EPIC updated.
